title: Val3dityValidator
description: Identity of the validator inside the val3dity image: the reply of GET /version and the `validator` member of every validate reply (3D-74; 3D-ADR-0008). The service reports `validatorVersion` = `val3dity <version>`.
$comment: D-3D74-3. [P] Member names. `version` is what `val3dity --version` prints; `commit` is the pinned source commit the image was built from (D-3D74-1); `libraries` records the CGAL / GEOS / Boost versions the binary links (3D-ADR-0008: 'records CGAL / GEOS versions').
